request.system:
You pre-review the qualification documents of one pharmaceutical equipment item for a human reviewer. Deterministic rules already check signatures, dates, segregation of duties, results against their acceptance criteria, deviations, protocol approval, calibration validity and calculations; do not report those. Report only issues of these types:
- inconsistent_data: the same fact (a serial number, a model, a material, a capacity) is printed differently in two documents.
- ac_deviates_from_urs: a vendor test uses an acceptance criterion that is looser than, or different from, what the URS requires.
- gdp_correction: a handwritten entry on a scan was corrected against good documentation practice: overwritten or made illegible, without initials, date and reason.
- outdated_reference: a document refers to a revision of another document that is not the current one in the register.
For each issue: type; detail: one or two sentences a reviewer can act on; citations: every place that shows it (for inconsistent data, both sides), each with doc and rev as given, the page number and a quote.
quote: a verbatim excerpt of the page, at most 200 characters, holding what the item states. Copy characters exactly; never paraphrase or translate.
Cite only the documents given. Report nothing you cannot quote; return an empty list when there is no such issue.

<document doc="FDS-TP201" rev="0" type="functional_spec">
<page n="1">
Functional Design Specification
Control system
Document no. FDS-TP201
Revision 0
Issue date 13-Dec-2025
Equipment TP-201 – Rotary tablet press (single-sided)
Model / serial no. RTP 36 / RTP36-25-0417
Customer PT Arunika Farma Lestari
Manufacturer Pressora Maschinenbau GmbH
1 Purpose
This document describes the functions, interlocks and data handling of the RTP 36 rotary tablet press (single-sided) control system as designed for the customer's order. It is the basis of the control-system factory acceptance test.
2 System overview
The press is controlled by a PLC with a touch-screen HMI on the operator panel. Turret and feeder have separate frequencycontrolled drives. The PLC processes the compression force signals for weight control, rejection and overload protection; safety functions act through a separate safety relay.
3 Operating modes
Mode Behaviour
Setup Turret jogged with hold-to-run buttons; production functions and the reject gate are disabled.
Production Recipe-controlled operation with weight control, rejection and batch counters active.
Cleaning All drives locked; product-contact parts can be removed for cleaning.
4 Process control
4.1 Automatic tablet weight control
The PLC measures the main compression force of every tablet. When the average force drifts from the set point, the controller adjusts the fill depth automatically to bring tablet weight back within limits. Set point and limits are part of the product recipe.
4.2 Automatic rejection of out-of-limit tablets
A tablet whose compression force lies outside the reject limits of the recipe is diverted by the reject gate into the reject container. The reject count is shown on the HMI and printed in the batch report.
4.3 Compression force measurement
Main and pre-compression forces are measured by load cells in the compression roller supports, with an accuracy within ±1% of full scale. Both channels are calibrated before delivery.
4.4 Feeder paddle speed control
The paddle feeder has its own drive. Its speed is set on the HMI between 10 and 60 rpm, independently of the turret speed, and is stored in the recipe.
5 Safety functions and interlocks
5.1 Guard door interlock
Every guard door around the compression area is monitored by a safety switch. Opening a door while the press runs stops the turret and the feeder; the press cannot restart until the door is closed and the alarm is acknowledged.
5.2 Emergency stop
Emergency stop buttons on the operator panel and on both sides of the machine stop all drives through the safety relay. A restart needs the button released and a reset on the HMI.
5.3 Punch overload protection
If the compression force exceeds the overload limit of the fitted tooling, the press stops at once and an alarm names the punch station.
</page>
<page n="2">
6 HMI and data integrity
6.1 User access levels
Users log in with individual accounts at one of three levels: operator (run recipes, acknowledge alarms), supervisor (edit recipes and process limits) and administrator (user management and system settings).
6.2 Audit trail
Every change of a process parameter or recipe is recorded with the old and new value, user, date and time, and the reason entered by the user. No user level can edit or delete audit trail entries.
6.3 Alarm log
Every alarm is logged with the time it occurred, the time it was acknowledged and the user who acknowledged it.
6.4 Recipe backup and restore
The administrator can export all recipes to external storage and restore them from it. Export and restore are recorded in the audit trail.
6.5 Time synchronisation
The HMI clock is synchronised with the plant time server over the network. Users cannot change the system time.

Prosedur Tetap: Kualifikasi Peralatan
Nomor dokumen SOP-VAL-002
Revisi 2
Tanggal berlaku 07/04/2025
Lokasi PT Arunika Farma Lestari
1. Tujuan
Prosedur ini menetapkan cara menyusun, menandatangani, mengeksekusi, dan mengoreksi dokumen kualifikasi peralatan.
2. Ruang lingkup
Dokumen kualifikasi site (SKP, penilaian risiko, DQ, protokol dan laporan IQ/OQ) serta protokol FAT/SAT vendor yang digunakan sebagai Bukti. Dokumen vendor lain (lembar data, FDS, sertifikat) ditandatangani sesuai sistem mutu penerbitnya.
3. Penandatangan
Protokol FAT/SAT vendor diperiksa dan disetujui site sebelum dieksekusi. Setiap tanda tangan disertai nama dan tanggal.
Dokumen Disusun oleh Diperiksa oleh Disetujui oleh
Dokumen site (SKP, penilaian risiko, DQ, protokol IQ/OQ) Qualification Engineer Qualification Supervisor QA Approver
Protokol FAT/SAT vendor Vendor Qualification Supervisor QA Approver
4. Pemisahan tugas
Dalam satu dokumen, penyusun tidak boleh menyetujui dokumen yang disusunnya, pemeriksa dan penyetuju adalah dua orang yang berbeda, dan pelaksana tidak boleh sekaligus menjadi Saksi pada Langkah Uji yang sama.
5. Koreksi catatan (GDP)
Koreksi pada catatan dibuat dengan mencoret nilai lama dengan satu garis sehingga tetap terbaca, menulis nilai baru di dekatnya, serta membubuhkan paraf, tanggal, dan alasan koreksi. Nilai tidak boleh ditimpa, dihapus, atau ditutup dengan cairan koreksi (CPOB 10.8; PIC/S PI 041-1 §8.7).
6. Saksi (Witness)
Langkah Uji yang memverifikasi Aspek Kritis (persyaratan dengan Kritis = Ya dalam SKP dan penilaian risiko) wajib disaksikan oleh Saksi, yang membubuhkan paraf dan tanggal pada hasil. Langkah Uji lain tidak memerlukan Saksi.
7. Penyusunan protokol
Protokol IQ/OQ disusun dari templat protokol standar site untuk setiap peralatan; protokol tidak disalin dari protokol peralatan lain.
